caption: The drawing shows two earrings, each illustrated individually against a plain beige background. Both earrings predominantly feature black elements with gold-colored hooks and small accent details. The earring on the left is composed of a round black bead at the top, beneath which is a horizontal black rectangle. Hanging from the rectangle are three elongated, teardrop-shaped black pendants, each affixed by small gold loops. The earring on the right has a simpler structure, with a round black bead at the top, a small black triangular detail attached to one side, and a single long, black teardrop-shaped pendant hanging below, also attached by a gold loop. Both earrings hang from simple, curved gold hooks. The artist's name, "John H. Tercuzzi," is written in faint letters in the lower left corner.
title: Earrings
